decisions.reason: Because the SEO support service has been publicly maintained on its own page across 2023 and 2024, management is likely to justify the prior investment and attribute any weaker uptake to temporary market conditions rather than withdraw it soon.

As a newly launched workshop offering with its own page in 2024, it has visible commitment but less accumulated investment than D, so management would still likely keep it for another year while giving it time to prove itself.
